$comment: Fixed-name paths under the shared /tmp that shipped files may contain. tests/test_tmp_path_policy.py scans every tracked text file outside tests/, .claude/ and this file for /tmp/<name> and fails on any (file, path) pair not listed here, and on any entry here that no longer matches. Any account on a machine can create /tmp/<name> before the intended user does, so prefer PrivateTmp=yes, RuntimeDirectory=/StateDirectory=, mktemp -d, or a root-owned /run/<name>. An entry needs a reason it is safe.
